steps.description: The hands retrieve a tomato from the refrigerator, remove its sticker, rinse it, and set it on the counter.
steps.done_when: a clean whole tomato is ready on the work surface
steps.title: Take a tomato

steps.description: The hands strip cilantro leaves onto a white board and chop them finely then portion them with a measuring spoon.
steps.done_when: finely chopped cilantro is portioned and ready to add
steps.title: Chop the cilantro

steps.description: The hands place a small blue bowl on the board, fetch an egg, crack it, and drop it into the bowl.
steps.done_when: one cracked raw egg is contained in the bowl
steps.title: Crack an egg into bowl
steps.keystep: crack one egg in a bowl

steps.description: The hands hold the washed tomato steady on the board and slice it through the middle with a knife.
steps.done_when: the tomato is divided into two halves
steps.title: Halve the tomato

steps.description: The hands gather the chopped cilantro from the board and drop it into the bowl with the egg.
steps.done_when: the herbs are combined with the egg in the bowl
steps.title: Add cilantro to egg
steps.keystep: add the chopped cilantro to the bowl

steps.description: The hands measure ground black pepper and sprinkle it into the bowl containing egg and herbs.
steps.done_when: seasoning is added to the egg mixture
steps.title: Season with black pepper
steps.keystep: add 1/2 tsp ground black pepper to the bowl

steps.description: The hands hold the bowl and whisk the egg, herbs, and pepper together with a fork.
steps.done_when: the contents are uniform and beaten ready for cooking
steps.title: Beat the mixture
steps.keystep: beat the contents of the bowl

steps.description: The hands measure oil into a small non-stick pan, place it on the burner, turn on heat, and swirl to coat.
steps.done_when: oil is hot and evenly coating the pan for frying
steps.title: Heat oil in pan
steps.keystep: heat 1 tbsp oil in a non-stick frying pan

steps.description: The hands lay both tomato halves cut-side down in the hot oil and leave them to sizzle, checking until softened and colored.
steps.done_when: tomatoes are softened and colored on the cut side
steps.title: Fry tomato halves
steps.keystep: cook the tomatoes cut-side down until they start to soften and colour

steps.description: The hands slide utensils under the softened tomatoes and lift them free from the pan surface.
steps.done_when: tomatoes are freed and lifted from the cooking surface
steps.title: Scoop tomatoes out
steps.keystep: scoop the tomatoes from the pan

steps.description: The hands transfer the cooked tomato halves onto a white serving plate.
steps.done_when: cooked tomatoes are resting on the serving plate
steps.title: Plate the tomatoes
steps.keystep: put tomatoes on a serving plate

steps.description: The hands lift the blue bowl and pour the beaten herb-egg mixture into the hot oiled pan.
steps.done_when: all liquid egg mixture is in the pan to cook
steps.title: Pour egg into pan
steps.keystep: pour the egg mixture into the pan

steps.description: The hands gently push and stir the setting egg in the pan to let uncooked liquid flow to the base.
steps.done_when: set and liquid egg are redistributed for even cooking
steps.title: Stir egg gently
steps.keystep: stir gently with a wooden spoon so the egg that sets on the base of the pan moves to enable the uncooked egg to flow into the space

steps.description: The hands stop stirring and leave the nearly-set egg undisturbed to firm into a round shape.
steps.done_when: the egg is set as a cohesive omelette
steps.title: Let omelette set
steps.keystep: stop stirring when it's nearly cooked to allow it to set into an omelette

steps.description: The hands slide the cooked herb omelette from the pan onto the plate alongside the fried tomatoes.
steps.done_when: omelette and tomatoes are plated together ready to serve
steps.title: Serve omelette with tomatoes
steps.keystep: transfer omelette to the plate and serve with the tomatoes

task_summary: Make a herb omelet served with fried tomatoes in a home kitchen.
